meta.title: OpenCut v3 — production pipeline · 生产流水线
meta.subtitle: From still images + domain config to finished 1080×1920 mp4 · 从静态图与领域配置到成片

views.label: Ingest and draft · 接入与撰写
views.note: Operator uploads assets, the LLM script writer drafts the narration, and edge-tts renders the voiceover.

views.label: Align and detect · 对齐与检测
views.note: The aligner scores stills against the audio timeline; the composer adds face-detected cut markers.

views.label: Compose and deliver · 合成与交付
views.note: BGM and subtitles are laid in, the renderer writes the 1080×1920 mp4, and the operator receives the finished video.

messages.label: images + domain config · 图像 + 领域配置
shot list + cut plan · 分镜 + 切换方案
visual timeline ready · 视觉时间线就绪
BGM + subtitles muxed · 混音字幕

cards.title: Ingest · 接入
items: Operator drops still images and a domain config · 运营者上传静态图与领域配置
Domain preset (education / travel / knowledge_paid / custom) drives prompts · 领域预设驱动 prompt
One bounded job per upload · 一次上传对应一次闭环任务

cards.title: Analyze · 分析
items: LLM script writer drafts narration + shot list · LLM 撰写旁白与分镜
edge-tts renders the voiceover track · edge-tts 输出配音轨
Aligner scores stills against the audio beat · 对齐器按节拍匹配图像

cards.title: Act · 执行
items: OpenCV face detection places camera cuts · 人脸检测决定切换点
Composer layers BGM and subtitles · 合成器叠加 BGM 与字幕
Renderer writes the 1080×1920 mp4 back to the operator · 渲染器回写成片
